CABLE ADDRESS, BUVALE

TELEPHONE, MAIN 3928

10.

MARION BUTLER BUTLER & VALE ATTORNEYS AT LAW SOUTHERN BUILDING

WASHINGTON, D.C.

J.M.VALE

May 22nd, 1914.

ark

Col. Theo. Roosevelt, Oyster Bay, I. I. New York.

Dear Mr. President, Confirming my telegram, Mrs. Butler and I will be delighted to have you as our guest while you are in Washington

next week, on the occasion of your lecture before the National Geographical Society.

Trusting that we will have the

pleasure of entertaining you, and that your health is being rapidly restored, I am, Very sincerely yours, Manau Bustic
